ultimate_miles.title: DOING MY OWN THING
ultimate_miles.text: Fading into the shadows, locking down the enemy, and delivering devastating Venom Strikes, Miles completely controlled the pace of the battle.

deck.name: Invisibility
deck.effect_text: You cannot take any damage until the beginning of your next turn.

deck.name: Venom Strike
deck.effect_text: ✸ ✸ against a single enemy in your Location.

deck.name: Web
deck.effect_text: If you are in the same Location that the Villain, delay the next Villain Turn by one card.
